parameters.name: AudioFormat
parameters.description: The audio format. Only **wav**, **mp3**, and **amr** formats are supported.

parameters.name: BizCode
parameters.description:
The corpus identifier. When a device calls multiple corpora for combined playback, this identifier is used to play the specified corpus.

- When **Corpus type** is set to **Custom corpus**, this parameter is required. The corpus identifier is user-defined and supports letters and digits with a length of 1 to 32 characters. It must be unique within the project. We recommend setting the pinyin initials of the corpus semantics as the identifier, for example: `Payment received` can be set to `ZFDZ`.

- When **Corpus type** is set to **Common corpus**, the corpus identifier is automatically generated by the system and does not need to be user-defined.

parameters.name: EnableSoundCode
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the sound code. If this parameter is set to true, you must specify the SoundCodeConfig parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

><notice>
- If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no ID value exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

parameters.name: ProjectCode
parameters.description: The project ID, which is the unique identifier of the project. You can obtain the project ID from the [Project Management console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/things-service/projects). If no project exists, create a project to obtain the project ID.

parameters.name: SoundCodeConfig
parameters.description:
The sound code configuration, which includes the following fields:


- **SoundCodeContent**: The marketing content of the sound code, such as the product details URL.

- **AdditionalDuration**: The sound code playback duration after the corpus playback ends. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 1 to 15.

parameters.name: SpeechRate
parameters.description: The playback speed. Valid values: -500 to 500.

parameters.name: SpeechType
parameters.description:
The corpus type. Valid values: custom corpus and common corpus.

> If this parameter is not specified or is set to **custom**, you must specify the Text and BizCode parameters. Otherwise, the call fails.

- Custom corpus (default): Set the value to **custom**. If the corpus is a custom corpus, you must specify the corpus identifier and corpus text.
- Common corpus: Common corpus text preset by the system, which includes the following types:
    - Digits: Set the value to **number**. Includes: digits 0-9, dot, and one.
    - Quantifiers: Set the value to **measure_word**. Includes: piece, ten, hundred, thousand, ten thousand, hundred thousand, million, and billion.
    - Currency units: Set the value to **monetary_unit**. Includes: cent, dime, and yuan.
    - Time units: Set the value to **time_unit**. Includes: hour, minute, second, month, day, and year.
    - Unit time: Set the value to **unit_time**. Includes: per second, per minute, per hour, per day, per week, per month, and per year.
    - Length units: Set the value to **length_unit**. Includes: millimeter, centimeter, decimeter, meter, kilometer, inch, foot, and mile.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: The corpus text. This parameter is required when the corpus type is set to custom corpus. The corpus text supports letters, Chinese characters, and spaces with a length of 1 to 100 characters. A Chinese character occupies two characters.

parameters.name: Voice
parameters.description: The voice for corpus playback, which is preset by the system, such as standard female voice or standard male voice. You can query available voice types by calling [GetSpeechVoice](~~217887~~) and use the **Value** in **VoiceList** from the response parameters.
